blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio on Thursday called on the Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc) and the leadership of the House of Representatives to provide a detailed committee report on the amendments that will be made regarding the proposed national budget for 2027. The BARSc will begin its deliberations on the amendments on the national budget on Thursday, October 1. According to House Secretary General Atty. Cheloy Garafil, the proceedings will be livestreamed to the public to ensure transparency.
